ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets, several clustered florets with fine bumpy tops and short pale green stems, slightly moist surface, sitting on the left side of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 4 cm tall | 110
ITEM 2 | Breaded or crumb-coated cutlet-like pieces, golden-tan to light brown crust with a coarse, crumbly texture, several slices about 6 cm long and 2 cm thick arranged on the upper right, with some green flecks showing between them | 140
ITEM 3 | Thin, crisp-looking yellow-orange fried or baked slices with browned, slightly charred edges and dark green streaks, curled and layered, dry-looking with a light sheen, lying at the lower right of the plate, about 7 cm by 5 cm and 0.5 cm thick | 45
